resources.string: Background reply checks · Beta
Check for replies every six hours using your existing Community identity. Requires Android notification permission. Re-enable after changing accounts.
Set up your Community identity before enabling background reply checks.
New replies are available. Tap to open the saved inbox.
Community similar titles · Beta

Add a manual Details action for similar titles. Sends the selected title’s source and identifier to the Community service; history and statistics stay on this device. Separate from local suggestions; inactive in Legacy mode. Source selection is always manual.
No compatible titles were returned. Availability depends on the Community service and your content filters.
Animated menus · Beta
Reveal popup menus with a rounded animation. Follows the system animation setting.
Blur behind bars · Beta
Blur only the main screen content behind the status bar and floating navigation bar. Requires Android 13 or newer; uses extra graphics processing.
Show in TV launcher · Beta
Show the existing app entrance in Android TV launchers. The regular launcher is unaffected; some screens still require touch or a pointer.
Refresh cover
Show Refresh cover action
Add a Details menu action to fetch its online cover again, bypassing cached images.
Preload nearby covers · Beta
Load up to two small covers ahead when a list stops scrolling, on an unmetered connection. Uses extra data; skips private libraries, local books and Incognito mode.
Retain more adjacent pages · Beta
With sufficient memory, keep up to two more pages on each side in paged mode, or two more cached holders in webtoon mode. Uses more RAM; applies when opening the reader.
Sort chapter list by upload date
Use upload dates for chapter lists by default. Reading order and progress stay unchanged. Unknown dates appear last; each title can override this in its chapter menu.
Unread updates only
Hide opened feed entries without deleting them. Turn off to show all updates again.
